verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature, such as scheduled jobs, rules, or background workflows, that a user can set up to run on its own. The 'automated onboarding, split payments, and settlements' line describes dLocal's internal processing, and recurring charges via card_id still require the merchant to call the API. Webhooks and the MCP server are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward user-defined background automations.
